lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly-ordered grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-to-upper lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal spot rows to form a rectilinear coordinate system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients (light upper edges/shadowed lower edges) running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A white trailing tag or external attachment is visible at the posterior insertion point of the pectoral fin. A complex, non-natural marking resembling a geometric scar or brand is located on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, high-contrast marking consisting of interconnected linear scars forming a square or box-like shape is present on the central flank, distinct from the biological spot pattern.
